why: Makes the shipped `shape` marker mode-blind (issue #922): teams tanks get slot shapes in team colours, which is the confusion #923 describes, and co-op campaign rings change although the ruling on #234 covered FFA only. The single-player ring is still gated by `identityApplies` (two or more player tanks) in entities.ts, so only the renderer OPTION shows it there. Killed by the resolver's non-FFA case and by the loop case that boots teams from the pane, co-op and single-player.
